extracted.intended_audience: Internet Archive users, media collectors, and archivists browsing/downloading a cataloged media item
extracted.subtask_description: A single Internet Archive item detail/catalog page for a VHS media item showing metadata, download options, user reviews, and moderation/flagging categories. The page is intended to present item metadata and provide user actions (download, share, flag, review).

rubrics_metrics.name: Graphic Violence
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the flagging categories listed under 'Flag this item for' on the item page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows users to report the item if it contains graphic depictions of violence. No further guidance or examples are provided on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explicit Sexual Content
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the flagging categories listed under 'Flag this item for' on the item page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows users to report sexually explicit material. The page lists the label but gives no additional explanation or thresholds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hate Speech
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the flagging categories listed under 'Flag this item for' on the item page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to report content containing hate speech; the page provides this category as an option without extended guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Misinformation/Disinformation
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the flagging categories listed under 'Flag this item for' on the item page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended for reporting false or misleading content. The page only lists the category name; no criteria for judging misinformation are provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marketing/Phishing/Advertising
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the flagging categories listed under 'Flag this item for' on the item page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For reporting items that appear to be marketing, phishing attempts, or spammy advertising; no further examples or thresholds are supplied on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Misleading/Inaccurate/Missing Metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the flagging categories listed under 'Flag this item for' on the item page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows users to report problems with the item's metadata (e.g., incorrect or missing descriptive information). The page lists the label but offers no specific guidance on what constitutes misleading or missing metadata.
